description:
Turn a version's container into ENTERPRISE by mounting the enterprise addons from the CUSTOMER's
    licensed .deb. PREREQUISITE: the licensed Enterprise .deb is ALREADY on the box at `deb_path`
    (you place it - Zoxron never ships it). Unpacks it, isolates the ENTERPRISE-ONLY modules (those
    in the .deb but NOT already in the community image) from the COMPLETE addons tree (.../odoo/addons),
    and copies them to base_dir/enterprise (mounted :ro, first on that service's addons_path). The
    .deb + its expansion stay on the box, never served.
    YOU must hold a valid Odoo Enterprise subscription - pass subscription_confirmed=true to affirm
    (Zoxron never supplies or validates the licence). dry_run shows the script.
name: docker_ee_mount
